messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy notice: starting canary rollout for v2 -> eu-west-1 on /api. Canary id=canary-42. Notifying eng-releases. Status=RUNNING
jamie: seeing a sudden uptick in 503s from tenant=legacy-org-14 right after the traffic shift, +7% in 30s
maria: ugh. can you paste a quick tail of the proxy logs?
jamie: tl;dr from logs:
```
[2024-06-10T22:03:20Z] proxy: upstream v2 returned 503 for tenant=legacy-org-14: conn reset
[2024-06-10T22:03:21Z] routing: routed request with header X-Client-Version=1.1 -> v2
[2024-06-10T22:03:22Z] client: legacy-org-14 reported timeout on async call
```
alex: looks like header-negotiation logic is binding v1 clients to v2 in some edge cases (missing casefold or empty header fallback). could be a regression in the header-normalizer change from last deploy
maria: can we pause the canary and pin legacy-org-14 back to v1 until we triage?
jamie: +1 to pin. ops-sre-bot please apply tenant pin and pause canary. ops-sre-bot run: `/deploybot pin-tenant legacy-org-14 v1 --until 2024-06-11T01:00:00Z`
ops-sre-bot: Command received: `/deploybot pin-tenant legacy-org-14 v1 --until 2024-06-11T01:00:00Z`. Ready to apply. Confirm? :eyes:
alex: confirm. also suggest temporary gateway rule: if X-Client-Version missing or unparsable -> route to v1 (safe-fallback)
maria: I can push a small hotfix to the gateway to add that gate if ops wants to keep pin short
ops-sre-bot: Pin applied: legacy-org-14 -> v1. Canary paused by operator. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Canary status update: PAUSED by operator. Notes: tenant pin applied. Next steps: 1) pin tenant (done); 2) apply header gate hotfix; 3) smoke tests; 4) gradual resume. Monitoring to watch: 5xx rate, p50/p95/p99 latency, and client error counts. Alert rule: trigger if 5xx > 2% sustained for >2m (incidents channel).
jamie: after pin the 503 spike dropped back to baseline within ~40s, graphs look much better :thumbsup:
maria: I'll draft a short release-note blurb and ping support to update the runbook & customer notice
alex: suggested release note copy: "Temporary tenant pin for legacy-org-14 due to header negotiation regression. We applied a safe-fallback and will roll a header-gate hotfix; planned resume in the next change window after verification."
maria: @support-team please escalate to CS and put a brief note in the tenant's incident record
support-notify-bot: Message queued to #support with subject: "legacy-org-14 temporary pin to v1 after 503 spike"
jamie: reassigning the canary ticket to eng-runtime to root-cause header parsing on v2 edge and add unit test for header casefolding
maria: thanks everyone. will follow up once the hotfix is staged. closing this thread for the immediate ops action. :v:
